falseSynonyms.zh: 圖片不等於所有藝術作品 picture 可以是照片、插圖或一般圖像；artwork 可以包括雕塑、裝置等非平面作品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A picture is usually an image. A work of art may be a painting, sculpture, installation, or other artistic creation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 畫作不等於所有藝術作品 painting 只是一種藝術作品；artworks 的範圍可以更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A painting is one type of artwork. Artworks can also include sculptures, photographs, and installations.

falseSynonyms.zh: 雕塑不等於所有藝術作品 sculpture 只指立體雕塑作品，不能泛指所有 artworks。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A sculpture is a three-dimensional artwork. A collection of artworks may contain many different media.

falseSynonyms.zh: 裝飾品不等於藝術作品 decoration 的主要功能是裝飾；藝術作品不一定以裝飾為目的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A decoration is used to make something look attractive. A work of art is created as an artistic expression.

falseSynonyms.zh: 設計不等於完成的藝術作品 design 可以是構思、圖樣或方案，未必是完成的藝術品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A design may be a plan or pattern. An artwork is the artistic work itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 手工藝不等於所有藝術作品 crafts 常指以技巧製作的手工藝品；與藝術作品有重疊，但範圍和語境不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Crafts may emphasize skilled making. Works of art may include both crafted objects and other artistic forms.

falseSynonyms.zh: 藝術家不等於藝術作品 artists 是創作作品的人；artworks 是被創作出來的作品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Artists create artworks. The words refer to people and their creations respectively.

falseSynonyms.zh: 單數與複數不同 artwork 可作單數或集合概念；artworks 明確指多件作品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON This artwork is on loan. These artworks belong to the museum.
